tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje rin po che la nang so rgya mtsho bas zhus pa sdom gsum gyi dris lan zhes bya ba// rje rin po che'i dgongs pa/ sdom pa gsum gnad gcig cing yar ldan dang*/ rigs spyod kyi tshul khrims su bzhed gsungs 'dug kyang*/ deng sang dge slong gis las rgya sogs sngags kyi spyod pa gtso bor byed pa 'di/ rje rin po che'i dgongs pa yin byas 'dug pa/ de ltar lags sam/ zhes pa'i lan du/ spyir sdom pa gsum la yar ldan/ 'chol bsrung*/ gnad gcig rab dbye/ rnam gzhag la sogs pa 'dug pa las/ rang res gnad gcig nyams su len dgos pas/ 'di tshor yang kha cig las rgya la sogs pa byed pa byung ba dang*/ khyed khams nas kyang rab tu byung*/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ chang dang srog gcod pa la mi 'dzem pa zhig snang ba/ 'di tsho 'chol ba yin pas/ sdom par byed dgos pas/ nged rang ye bkag ye gnang dpang du btsugs pa'i bstan pa la gang phan byed dgos rgyu yin pas de ltar mdzod/ chos rje rin po che la sdom gsum gyi zhu ba zhus len dang bcas pa'o/// /
